description: A React component class 'TeamList' for displaying and managing a list of teams in the Mattermost admin console, including search, filtering, pagination, and navigation.

classes.name: TeamList
classes.description: A React component for listing teams with search, filter, and pagination features.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to load initial page data.

methods.name: isSearching
methods.description: Determines if a search or filter is active based on term and filters.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination display info like start and end counts.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of team data, either via getData or searchTeams.

methods.name: searchTeams
methods.description: Performs team search with given term and filters, updates state.

methods.name: searchTeamsDebounced
methods.description: Debounced version of searchTeams to limit API calls.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of team data.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, resets to page 0.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid.

methods.name: renderManagementMethodText
methods.description: Returns display text for team's management method.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates row data for the grid based on current data and state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component including DataGrid with props.
